name: core
description: Always-on working discipline for every project: mirror intent and hold brainstorm phases until an explicit greenlight, integrate reference code with every behavioral deviation approved first, post timed status and ETA tables for long-running tasks, and tag each project with its categories so domain plugins such as research load only where they belong.

interface.shortDescription: Intent gating, reference code, progress updates, tags
interface.longDescription: Skills that belong in every project. Mirror the user's request back before acting, and hold brainstorm phases with no plan or code until an explicit greenlight. Integrate reference implementations with mechanical changes reported and behavioral deviations user-approved. Post a fixed status and ETA table on a timed cadence for transfers, downloads, runs, and other long-running tasks. Tag a project with its categories in .project.toml and generate each host's per-project plugin enablement from it, so domain plugins such as research load only in the projects that use them.
defaultPrompt: Show me that you understood my request before doing anything, then hold in brainstorm phase until I greenlight the plan.
Tag this project as a research project so the research skills load here.
Port this reference implementation into my codebase and show me every deviation first.
